description: Experimental A15/W-P candidates assembled only from the paper-validated Sigma3 and Sigma5 Tet pairs.

candidates.hypothesis: Published positive control: a rank-3 CTB anchor network should transform toward the Euler-catenoid network.
Remove the X-directed CTB anchor while retaining Y/Z locking; test an anisotropic two-catenoid or new open-X topology.
Remove the Y-directed CTB anchor while retaining X/Z locking; symmetry partner of open-X used to detect numerical bias.
Remove the Z-directed CTB anchor while retaining X/Y locking; symmetry partner of the other rank-2 candidates.
Keep rank-3 CTB locking but exchange which X-Tet orientation faces Dod0/Dod1, changing the asymmetric ordinary-GB distribution.
Y-axis counterpart of the single-pair exchange; checks whether the selected evolution is rotationally robust.
Z-axis counterpart of the single-pair exchange; preserves all three CTB channels but changes surrounding GB characters.
A single X-directed CTB channel tests whether one-dimensional fencing can seed a cylindrical minimal-surface morphology.
Y-axis counterpart of the rank-1 anchor candidate.
Z-axis counterpart of the rank-1 anchor candidate.
Published negative control: no Sigma3 CTB network and no expected Euler transformation.
